cards.front: Al ver sangre, me mareo.
cards.back: At the first sight of blood, I come over all giddy.

cards.front: De repente él se mareó.
cards.back: He suddenly came over all dizzy.

cards.front: En cuanto ella vio el cuerpo, se mareó.
cards.back: As soon as she saw the body, she came over all queasy.

cards.front: Dentro de una hora le había salido un sarpullido terrible.
cards.back: Within an hour he'd come out in a terrible rash.

cards.front: Cuando como chocolate, siempre me salen granos.
cards.back: When I eat chocolate, I always come out in spots.

cards.front: Jill no estará hoy; a su hijo le ha salido una urticaria.
cards.back: Jill won't be in today; her son's come out in hives.

cards.front: Suenas como si estuvieras cogiendo un resfriado.
cards.back: You sound like you're coming down with a cold.

cards.front: Él siempre está convencido de que está cogiendo algún tipo de enfermedad.
cards.back: He's always convinced that he's coming down with something or other.

cards.front: No te acerques demasiado; estoy cogiendo la gripe.
cards.back: Don't get too close; I'm coming down with flu.

cards.front: ¿Cuándo volvió en sí el paciente?
cards.back: When did the patient come around?

cards.front: Cuando por fin volví en mí, todo el mundo se había ido.
cards.back: When I eventually came around, everyone had gone.

cards.front: Ella volvió en sí media hora después de que la operación hubiera terminado.
cards.back: She came around half an hour after the operation had finished.

cards.front: Hubo momentos en que pensé que no sobreviviría.
cards.back: There were times I thought I wouldn't come through.

cards.front: ¿Él sobrevivió al final?
cards.back: Did he come through in the end?

cards.front: Es una enfermedad seria, pero la mayoría de la gente sobrevive.
cards.back: It's a serious illness, but most people come through.

cards.front: ¿Jeff confesó todo acerca del incidente con el tractor?
cards.back: Did Jeff come clean about the incident with the tractor?

cards.front: Es hora de confesar, o llamaremos a la policía.
cards.back: It's time to come clean, or we'll call the police.

cards.front: Tras horas de interrogación, él por fin confesó todo.
cards.back: After hours of interrogation, he finally came clean.

cards.front: ¿Cuándo va a entrar en razón y dimitir?
cards.back: When will he come to his senses and resign?

cards.front: Ella por fin entró en razón cuando lo vio con sus propios ojos.
cards.back: She finally came to her senses when she saw it with her own eyes.

cards.front: No te preocupes; él entrará en razón al final.
cards.back: Don't worry; he'll come to his senses in the end.

cards.front: Muchas culturas tienen ceremonias para celebrar la llegada a la mayoría de edad de un niño.
cards.back: Many cultures have ceremonies to celebrate a child's coming of age.

cards.front: Sabes que has llegado a la madurez cuando empiezas a pensar en...
cards.back: You know you've come of age when you start thinking about...

cards.front: No soporto las películas típicas de Hollywood sobre la adolescencia.
cards.back: I can't stand typical Hollywood coming-of-age movies.

cards.front: Da igual lo que la vida le depare, él siempre sale victorioso.
cards.back: It doesn't matter what life throws at him, he always comes out on top.

cards.front: Gente como ella casi siempre sale ganando.
cards.back: People like her nearly always come out on top.

cards.front: Salimos victoriosos, a pesar de todo lo que nos pasó.
cards.back: We came out on top, despite everything that happened to us.

cards.front: Has avanzado mucho desde la última vez que te vi.
cards.back: You've come a long way since I last saw you.

cards.front: Teniendo en cuenta que él empezó como músico callejero, ha llegado lejos.
cards.back: Considering he started out as a busker, he's come a long way.

cards.front: Él ha llegado lejos desde que le dejaste; ahora puede decir tu nombre sin perder el control.
cards.back: He's come a long way since you left him; he can now say your name without breaking down.

cards.front: Nacemos sin nada.
cards.back: We come into the world with nothing.

cards.front: El Estado de Israel se originó en 1948.
cards.back: The state of Israel came into being in 1948.

cards.front: Los científicos aún no han explicado cómo se originó el universo.
cards.back: Scientists haven't explained how the universe came into existence yet.

cards.front: Asegúrate de que la sustancia no entre en contacto con la piel.
cards.back: Make sure that the substance doesn't come into contact with your skin.

cards.front: A Jake le sale una urticaria siempre que cualquier parte de su piel entra en contacto con pelo de gato.
cards.back: Jake comes out in hives if any part of his skin comes into contact with cat hair.

cards.front: Si algo de eso hubiera entrado en contacto con una llama, habríamos tenido problemas.
cards.back: If any of it had come into contact with a naked flame, we would've been in trouble.

cards.front: Se rumorea que él heredará una fortuna cuando cumpla 21 años.
cards.back: Rumour has it that he'll come into a vast amount of money when he turns 21.

cards.front: Tras años viviendo en la pobreza, Ben de repente heredó dinero gracias a un pariente lejano.
cards.back: After years of living in poverty, Ben suddenly came into money thanks to a distant relative.

cards.front: La familia heredó mucho dinero justo después de la guerra.
cards.back: The family came into a lot of money just after the end of the war.

cards.front: ¿Cuándo entrará en vigor la nueva ley?
cards.back: When will the new law come into force?

cards.front: Mucha gente ha dejado de fumar desde que la ley anti-tabaco entró en vigor.
cards.back: Many people have given up smoking since the anti-smoking law came into force.

cards.front: Si esta ley entra en vigor, habrá manifestaciones.
cards.back: If that law comes into force, there will be demonstrations.

cards.front: Sarah se ha realizado desde que dejó la empresa y se convirtió en autónoma.
cards.back: Sarah has really come into her own since she left the company and went freelance.

cards.front: Desde que cambió de entrenador, Stephen ha alcanzado su potencial como jugador de tenis.
cards.back: Since he changed trainer, Stephen's come into his own as a tennis player.

cards.front: Roger se está realizando como abogado desde que ganó aquel caso.
cards.back: Roger is coming into his own as a lawyer since he won that case.

cards.front: Me llevé una sorpresa al enterarme de que le habían dado el trabajo a ella.
cards.back: It came as a surprise to hear that she got the job.

cards.front: La declaración de su compromiso fue, en cierto modo, una sorpresa.
cards.back: The announcement of their engagement came as something of a surprise.

cards.front: La noticia no debería sorprender a nadie.
cards.back: The news shouldn't come as a surprise to anybody.

cards.front: No me llevé ninguna sorpresa al enterarme de que había estado engañando a su mujer.
cards.back: It came as no surprise to find out that he had been cheating on his wife.

cards.front: No resultará nada sorprendente oír que el ganador de este año es...
cards.back: It will come as no surprise to hear that this year's winner is...

cards.front: No es ninguna sorpresa que le despidieran al final.
cards.back: It comes as no surprise that they fired him in the end.

cards.front: La noticia de su muerte nos conmocionó a todos.
cards.back: The news of his death came as a great shock to us all.

cards.front: Puede que les cause estupefacción oír que he cambiado mi nombre de Mark a Mandy.
cards.back: It might come as a shock to them to hear that I've changed my name from Mark to Mandy.

cards.front: Resulta asombroso saber que en realidad él nunca cantó ninguna de sus canciones.
cards.back: It comes as a shock to hear that he never actually sang any of his songs.

cards.front: Respiramos tranquilos al saber que llegaste a casa sano y salvo.
cards.back: It came as a relief to hear that you got home safe and sound.

cards.front: Es un gran alivio saber que no se va a perder ningún puesto de trabajo.
cards.back: It comes as a relief to hear that no jobs will be lost.

cards.front: Muchos inversores respirarán tranquilos al saber que sus acciones han vuelto a subir.
cards.back: It will come as a relief for many investors that their shares have gone back up again.

cards.front: Su divorcio se produjo como consecuencia de su consumo excesivo de alcohol.
cards.back: His divorce came as a result of his heavy drinking.

cards.front: La cura para esta enfermedad fue el resultado de años de intensa investigación.
cards.back: The cure for this disease came as a result of years of intensive research.

cards.front: La idea surgió como resultado de una conversación que tuve con mi hermana.
cards.back: The idea came as a result of a conversation that I had with my sister.

cards.front: En cuanto a la economía, no suelo entender ni una palabra de lo que la gente dice.
cards.back: When it comes to economics, I usually don't understand a thing people are saying.

cards.front: En lo que a fútbol se refiere, es imposible callarle a él.
cards.back: When it comes to talking about football, you can't get him to shut up.

cards.front: Cuando se trata de su familia, ella es muy cauta con todo lo que dice.
cards.back: When it comes to her family, she's very guarded about what she says.

cards.front: Si llegamos a eso, tendremos que cancelar todo.
cards.back: If it comes to that, we'll have to cancel everything.

cards.front: En ese caso tendrán que aceptar no estar de acuerdo.
cards.back: If it comes to that, they'll have to agree to disagree.

cards.front: Si llega a eso, es probable que le despidan a ella.
cards.back: If it comes to that, they're probably going to fire her.

cards.front: Ahora que lo pienso, él me dijo que no iba a ir.
cards.back: Now I come to think of it, he said he wasn't going to go.

cards.front: Pensándolo bien, sí que estaba con su ex novio.
cards.back: Come to think of it she was with her ex-boyfriend.

cards.front: Ahora que lo pienso, debí estar borracho si dije eso.
cards.back: Come to think of it I must have been drunk if I said that.

cards.front: Es lo que hemos llegado a esperar de ellos.
cards.back: It's what we have come to expect from them.

cards.front: Llegó a creer que todo el mundo iba en contra de ella.
cards.back: She came to believe that everybody was against her.

cards.front: Llegamos a sospechar que él fue el culpable.
cards.back: We came to suspect that he was the guilty one.

cards.front: Su actitud llegó a ser vista como un problema para todo el equipo.
cards.back: His attitude came to be seen as a problem for the whole team.

cards.front: ¿Cómo llegó Michael Jackson a ser conocido como «Wacko Jacko»?
cards.back: How did Michael Jackson come to be known as "Wacko Jacko"?

cards.front: No entiendo en qué momento llevar los vaqueros caídos llegó a ser considerado algo moderno.
cards.back: I don't understand when wearing your jeans halfway down your legs came to be considered fashionable!

cards.front: La situación con el entrenador alcanzó un punto crítico cuando Tony se negó a salir al campo como suplente.
cards.back: The situation with the manager came to a head when Tony refused to go onto the pitch as a substitute.

cards.front: Los problemas con su mujer alcanzaron un punto crítico cuando él no volvió a casa la otra noche.
cards.back: The problems with his wife came to a head when he failed to come home the other night.

cards.front: Las negociaciones han alcanzado un punto crítico; o llegan a un acuerdo pronto o habrá guerra.
cards.back: The negotiations have come to a head; either they come to an agreement soon or there'll be a war.

cards.front: Estoy intentando acordarme de la noche de la que me estás hablando, pero no me viene nada a la mente.
cards.back: I'm trying to remember the night you're talking about, but nothing comes to mind.

cards.front: ¿Te viene algo a la mente si te digo «Pimpinella»?
cards.back: Does anything come to mind if I say "Pimpinella"?

cards.front: Su nombre viene a la mente siempre que hablamos de los años ochenta.
cards.back: Her name comes to mind whenever we talk about the eighties.

cards.front: Él nunca llegó a asumir la muerte de su madre.
cards.back: He never came to terms with the death of his mother.

cards.front: Es muy difícil asimilar el hecho de que te vayas de la empresa.
cards.back: It's very hard coming to terms with the fact that you're leaving the company.

cards.front: Ya es hora de que aprendas a asimilar la realidad de la situación.
cards.back: It's about time you learned to come to terms with the reality of the situation.

cards.front: Nuevas revelaciones sobre su vida privada han salido a la luz.
cards.back: New revelations have come to light about his private life.

cards.front: ¿Alguna vez salió a la luz la verdad sobre su desaparición?
cards.back: Did the truth about his disappearance ever come to light?

cards.front: Cuando salió a la luz el escándalo nadie podía creer que fuese verdad.
cards.back: When the scandal first came to light, nobody could believe it was true.

cards.front: Es alucinante cuánta vida cobra él en cuanto sale al escenario.
cards.back: It's amazing how much he comes to life as soon as he goes on a stage.

cards.front: ¡Con qué rapidez te animaste cuando ella entró en la habitación!
cards.back: You soon came to life when she entered the room!

cards.front: El libro cobró vida cuando vi la película.
cards.back: The book really came to life when I saw the film.
